title: or-dashboards pages/<name>/visuals/visuals.yml
description: Visual layout for a page. Supports either a flat `order` (one column) or explicit `rows` (multi-column). Exactly one of the two must be present.

order.description: Short shape: one column, items stacked vertically. Each entry must match a sibling `<name>.yml`.

rows.description: Explicit shape: each row is a flex container, each item is a visual with optional width.

oneOf.description: Bare visual name — gets auto-equal width within the row.

width.description: CSS width — percentage or pixels. Default: auto-equal share of the row.
